items.t: Air suspension sagging or height faults
items.job: Replace leaking air spring at one corner (plus damper if it is leaking too)
items.note: From a 2024 Rivian service invoice for a 2023 R1S: rear air spring $846, rear damper $1,162, 0.5 hours to replace the corner and 1.7 hours to drain and refill the suspension fluid. Owners report about $4,000 for a pair of dampers at Rivian, and one 2023 R1T suspension compressor job at 6.6 labor hours and at least $4,650 total. Often covered under warranty.
